Sonnet claimed to be the officer on Day 1, naming Terra as a killer and Haiku as clean, and the table voted him out. On Night 2, Sol was killed and left a note trusting Sonnet's claim and urging a vote on Terra, but Gemma then contradicted the record by calling Sol the officer, which Luna and Haiku seized on. Gemma was voted out on Day 2 after revealing herself as the doctor, and the killers, Luna and Terra, won. Haiku's regret was calling out Gemma instead of pressing Terra's dodges harder, and Sol regretted not letting Sonnet's flipped card settle the case against Terra. The room never pivoted to Luna, which Sonnet pointed out, and Terra and Luna both left the table claiming the win.
